title: AI in the Gray: Exploring Moderation Policies in Dialogic Large Language Models vs. Human Answers in Controversial Topics

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with the Political Compass test and controversial topics from the Kialo debating platform, then analyzing the direct leanings of responses, the political affiliation of cited sources, and the ideological leaning (economic left/right and social libertarian/authoritarian) of generated arguments.
